about.text: A small goat cheese said to come from the foot of Mont Ventoux, made by hand from raw goat's milk. Its smooth, slightly tangy paste ripens 3 to 4 weeks in a dry, ventilated cellar, becoming firm and crumbly. Discs are about 7 cm across and 70 g.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
